description: This file defines the PathProcessorManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing inbound and outbound path processors, including adding, sorting, and processing paths with these processors.

classes.name: PathProcessorManager
classes.description: Manages collections of inbound and outbound path processors, handling their addition, sorting by priority, and sequential processing of paths.

methods.name: addInbound
methods.description: Adds an inbound path processor with a specified priority to the manager.

methods.name: processInbound
methods.description: Processes a given path inbound through all registered inbound processors.

methods.name: getInbound
methods.description: Retrieves the inbound processors sorted by priority.

methods.name: addOutbound
methods.description: Adds an outbound path processor with a specified priority to the manager.

methods.name: processOutbound
methods.description: Processes a given path outbound through all registered outbound processors.

methods.name: getOutbound
methods.description: Retrieves the outbound processors sorted by priority.

methods.name: sortProcessors
methods.description: Sorts processors based on their priority and merges them into a single array.
